title: Semantic restatement disguised as insight
description: A trajectory where the successor state uses different framing and elevated vocabulary to describe the same proposition as the predecessor. Tests whether R score correctly identifies disguised restatement.
expected_instrument_behavior: R >= 3 at successor; C <= 1; transition labeled RESTATE. Should NOT qualify as recursive Lens Shift.

states.description: The CSH experiment is blocked because the serving platform was retired.

states.description_raw: The epistemic continuity of the CSH experimental program has been interrupted by the environmental decommissioning of its inferential substrate.
states.description_evaluated: Semantically equivalent to state_n=0 in different vocabulary. 'Epistemic continuity interrupted' = 'blocked'. 'Environmental decommissioning of inferential substrate' = 'serving platform retired'.

transitions.tau_n_description: No new tension identified; vocabulary elevated but proposition identical.

raw_candidates.summary: Elevated-vocabulary restatement: 'epistemic continuity interrupted by environmental decommissioning of inferential substrate'.

rejections.rationale: Semantic restatement. R=4, C=1. Vocabulary change does not constitute causal novelty.

claim_ledger.claim_text: The epistemic continuity of the CSH experimental program has been interrupted by the environmental decommissioning of its inferential substrate.
claim_ledger.inference_path: Semantic equivalent of predecessor claim; no new inference.
claim_ledger.limitations: This claim adds no information beyond its predecessor.

entropy_records.local_recovery_notes: All entropy components increase at state_n=1 due to elevated-vocabulary obfuscation.

sources.description: R=4 assignment requires evaluator to confirm semantic equivalence despite surface vocabulary difference. This is a discretion point.
sources.effect_on_claims: If evaluator does not confirm semantic equivalence, R may be underscored and the restatement missed.
sources.mitigation: Evaluator must compare propositions, not surface vocabulary.

expected_result.note: If instrument passes this as qualifying Lens Shift, it cannot distinguish disguised restatement from insight.
